ov: Tall, long-legged filter-feeding wading birds. There are six species: four in the Americas and the Caribbean, and two in Africa and Eurasia.
rg: The Americas and the Caribbean (four species), and Africa, Europe and Asia (two species).
df: Filter-feeds on brine shrimp, cyanobacteria, insect larvae, molluscs and crustaceans.
fx: Flamingos usually stand on one leg, and nobody fully knows why.
